# Open Model Family Tree

> The ancestry of every model on the Hugging Face Hub, rebuilt nightly from declared base_model metadata. Generated 2026-11-18 from the 2026-11-18 Hub dump.

- 3,244,551 models tracked, 935,646 declare a base model, 968,996 parent links, 92,766 models have descendants.
- Counts are unique descendants (finetunes, adapters, quantizations, merges), each counted once.
